repos.description: Modular Monolith Java application with DDD
Generate easy-to-read web pages for your Architecture Decision Records
Machine-readable architecture decision records. Git-native decision memory and governance for human and agent-authored plans -- lint, CI, and MCP.
Decide-then-code. A Claude Code plugin that teaches every load-bearing decision, records your choice, and blocks code from moving past a decision you have not made yet.

Open-source ADR workflow for coding agents: 14 skills that scaffold and manage Architecture Decision Records, a plan queue and AGENTS.md conventions, then brainstorm, ship and audit decisions. One skill source for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot CLI, OpenCode, Grok, pi and omp. Works on one repo or a multi-repo product.

Architecture decisions your AI coding agents actually follow. Ranked ADR retrieval and context injection, deterministic pre-commit and CI enforcement with file:line citations, guided authoring, a staleness guardian, and a key-free MCP server. Native for Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, GitHub Copilot CLI and OpenCode. MIT.
Breadcrumbs adds traceability to spec-driven development, whatever approach you use.
Rust CLI and GitHub Action for Architecture Decision Records. Generate self-contained HTML viewers with faceted search, relationship graphs, and GitHub Wiki pages. Validate ADRs in CI/CD pipelines.
Provenance-first, versioned observatory of frontier AI models — releases, cards, prompts, evaluations, and evidence-bearing claims, for humans and models.
A single source of truth for software delivery. Use the Python CLI to link features, specs, and ADRs to claims, tests, and evidence, certify releases, and export lineage graphs.

Reconcile every AI coding agent's conversation history (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, Cursor, Aider, opencode, Cline +11 more) with git & docs into one cited ground truth — and generate ADR/PDR/BDR decision records. Local, deterministic, zero-deps agent skill.
Full-stack Solace PubSub+ workspace with a Spring Boot broker API, React publisher UI, Java subscriber, lifecycle tracking, retry, reconciliation, and architecture documentation.
Structurizr documentation of nf-core
Operating layer for durable AI work — mandates, evidence and human decisions across replaceable AI execution.
Knowledge as code for teams where agents implement: decisions and rules in markdown, approved by humans, checked in CI, and found by agents in seconds.
The repository standard: align, verify, drift 0. A method a repository can be measured against, and the tree it ships.
把開發規範寫成機器可讀的約束，讓 Claude 自動遵守 TDD、ADR、commit 閘門與發布檢查
Desktop app to design, specify, plan and ship a project with a team of people and AI agents. Specs, ADRs, diagrams, tickets, pull requests and agent runs in one Git repository.
Give your AI coding agent durable, checkable knowledge — decisions, facts, and guardrails it won't forget, contradict, or re-litigate. Claude Code / Codex / Kilo plugin marketplace.
Compiles git-backed markdown into a verifiable, read-optimized index for AI coding agents.
Controlled Human-led, Agent-orchestrated SDLC for decision-driven, traceable and verifiable AI-assisted software delivery.
Write your engineering conventions once, as questions. Each repository answers them for itself, coding agents follow the answers, and CI tells you when an answer is out of date.
Decision governance for code and the agents editing it — track PRD→ADR→SPEC decisions, map them to files, and gate changes against them. Deterministic, honest CLI + MCP.
Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) for AI coding assistants.
A plugin to generate a summary of a ADR directory

Showcase of a backend system with a complex domain made from scratch. Fast&Furious cinema project is a fully architected (modular monolith, event-driven architecture), documented (Architecture Decision Log, C4 model, event storming) and developed (deployment-ready functional-oriented and tested code).

Judge code changes against your architecture decision records, and find the records your code has quietly overtaken. CLI, pre-commit hook, GitHub Action and GitLab job; every CONFLICT verified against the diff and the ADR.
AI coding harness to plan, track and search decisions. Skills, rules, CLI and MCP that mandate a structured workflow for Claude Code and Codex.
Source-grounded assistance for investigating, comparing, and drafting architectural decisions without replacing the architecture owner.
Infrastructure as code for the Asymptora lab: Proxmox VE, LXC, and a segmented home network, managed with Ansible.
Keep the decision. Keep the why. Engineering decisions in Markdown: a Rust CLI for people and AI agents, with a local dashboard.
Decision records and agent reasoning, captured across parallel Claude Code sessions. One Go binary, no dependencies, collision-free ids under git worktrees.

Design decisions for Wax, an event-sourced .NET framework, and HiveAR, the free, open-source accounts receivable and debt collection platform being built on it by The OpenAR Collective, a vendor-neutral nonprofit. Read them, question them, and contribute what you know about how collections work; no coding required. Start with START-HERE.md.
Hot-swappable plugins for background work in .NET. Drop a versioned package in a folder: it loads in an isolated AssemblyLoadContext, the old version drains and unloads. No restart, no dropped work.
Architecture position pack for enterprise data platforms -- strategy, blueprints, and decision frameworks
The human-facing visual workspace for a Vaultspec project: browse records, source files and Git history.

The AI architecture for a SaaS usage assistant: text-to-SQL accuracy, tenant isolation and cost measured on three models and Databricks Genie, a default-deny query rewrite with an escape corpus in CI, and 14 decisions.
ADR management made simple and reliable for humans and agents.
AI-native CLI for Architecture Decision Records — built for AI coding agents
Deterministic-first decision governance — codify architecture decisions as enforceable rules.

Open-source decision and assurance framework for software products. 199 questions in a typed activation graph: answer 10 profile questions, load only the domains your subject warrants, end with one defensible gate decision. Markdown + YAML, no install. Built for humans and AI agents.
LLTH: a free, open-source harness for running open-weight language models privately on a single consumer GPU. Local-only, with no cloud or subscription.

A decision library for AI agent sessions. Agents submit plans and ADRs over MCP; you read, comment, and green- or red-light them; every verdict — including every rejection — becomes memory the agents can query. Local-first, MIT.
A local, traceable project memory for AI coding agents — MCP server + web UI over your Markdown, ADRs and agent memories
Production-style multi-agent LLM stack: orchestrator + specialists over A2A, LangGraph, MCP, Qdrant, LiteLLM, Langfuse. Human-designed (decisions in ADRs), AI-implemented.

A reference data architecture for a B2B SaaS company leaving Postgres: current state measured, options priced in its EU region, data model, governance and SOC 2 readiness, 18 decisions with machine-checked evidence, and a Databricks proof of concept.
A linter for keeping your specs, plans, and code in sync.
Maven Plugin to provide basic maintenance tasks managing Architectural Decision Records (ADR) in a maven project.
An ADR condom between production and your AI agent. Agents ask, you decide, hooks enforce.

System design knowledge base: 12 reference designs (video, messaging, social, job portal, e-commerce, multi-tenant SaaS, enterprise AI) with capacity models, ADRs and Mermaid diagrams · by Shiv Kumar, Software Architect
Vendor-neutral reference architecture for keeping control of identity, data, AI and integration: layers, decision records, maturity model.
Read, search and review folders of Markdown: specs, ADRs and notes. Highlight, annotate, and copy review notes for coding agents. macOS, Windows, Linux.

Investigative mystery game with LLM-driven NPCs. Deterministic case generation, an independent solver that gates solvability, and context isolation as an architectural boundary rather than a prompt instruction.

How one person runs generative AI in production: eight architecture decision records covering model selection, cost, IP and provenance policy, secrets, and how output acceptance is decided mechanically rather than by taste.
Best-practice baseline for my projects: repository structure, conventions, automation, documentation and architecture decisions. Clone before pouring concrete.

A small service desk on .NET 10, built to put Clean Architecture into practice: inward-only dependencies, the Result pattern, and two persistence adapters behind the same ports. An AI assistant was added later as an experiment. No longer developed.
Requirement-to-delivery dev kit for Claude Code: skills, agents and rules for requirements, ADRs, HLD/LLD, tasks, test plans, benchmarks and an implementation-readiness gate
Migración de una fintech monolítica a microservicios orquestados en AWS: ECS Fargate, API Gateway + VPC Link, ALB interno multi-AZ. Documentado con ADRs.
Design record and current specification for The Game Panel: RFCs, ADRs, spec and reference material, managed with ArchDoc.
Engineering case study for WorkTracker: offline-first systems, multi-tenancy, security, product decisions, and AI-assisted delivery.
Rust CLI for portable, agent-ready specifications, design records, and decisions, built on the Open Knowledge Format.
Sanitized ADRs and infrastructure patterns from production systems I have designed and operated
Canonical governance for the Macro Evidence organization and its platforms.

Static analysis for resilience configuration in microservice graphs. Finds where retry, timeout and circuit-breaker settings (Resilience4j, Istio, Spring) go past safe limits, computed from real config with sourced provenance.

Spec-driven development for AI coding agents, built on OpenSpec. Adds architecture reasoning scaled to the change, cross-model design and pre-ship review, test-first tasks, ADRs, a branch-per-change git and GitHub PR workflow, and milestone roadmaps. Skills for Claude Code, Codex and OMP.
Enforce Architecture Decision Records as executable rules — for both humans and AI agents
Architecture Decision Record (ADR)
Your ADRs are lying to you. MCP server with live drift detection, content safety, and decision memory — validates architectural decisions against your actual code.
Architectural drift prevention for the agentic AI SDLC.
